offering_description.value: Harmonic sells broadband access software and network equipment to cable operators and other internet service providers. Its software runs network functions on standard servers and works with equipment that connects subscribers over coaxial cable or fiber.

primary_products.value: virtualized cable modem termination software; remote PHY devices and access nodes; fiber access equipment; network management software

primary_services.value: network deployment and integration; contracted technical support and maintenance

customer_segment.value: B2B: Cable operators, telecommunications carriers and fiber internet service providers

revenue_model.value: product sales: Cable and fiber access hardware; licensing or royalties: Virtualized broadband access software licenses; subscription: Cloud-based network management and analytics; service fees: Deployment, integration and separately contracted maintenance
revenue_model.category: product sales; licensing or royalties; subscription; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Develops software that runs on standard servers and licenses it to broadband operators; OEM / manufacturer: Designs cable and fiber access equipment, uses contract manufacturing and sells to network operators; service provider: Uses broadband engineering expertise to deploy and maintain systems for operators
value_chain_position.category: software / platform; OEM / manufacturer; service provider

geography_served.value: global: North America, Latin America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Virtualized cable access, fiber access and broadband network management

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving cable operators and other broadband providers; partners / resellers: Regional channel partners and systems integrators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Broadband equipment is subject to FCC emissions rules and EU electromagnetic compatibility and product safety requirements.

notes: The profile assumes the announced sale of the video business to MediaKind closed on its expected 2026 timeline.
